proposals.title: Refresh company state through governed read-only bridge
proposals.description: Use the existing L4.5 bridge to request a fresh normalized company-state observation.
proposals.mission_relevance: Reduces founder step-by-step prompting by letting the agent team refresh mission context safely.
proposals.expected_business_value: Creates the first agent-team generated route from observation to governed tool result.
proposals.selection_reason: Best advances autonomy while staying local, read-only, and bridge-gated.

proposals.title: Convert top legacy triage candidate into wrapper plan
proposals.description: Turn a high-value legacy asset into a governed wrapper design without absorbing code.
proposals.mission_relevance: Improves governed tool coverage while preserving triage-before-absorption.
proposals.tool_need: read-only observation to inspect current triage summary
proposals.expected_business_value: Prepares future wrappers for dormant useful assets.
proposals.selection_reason: Valuable but less immediate than proving proposal-to-bridge routing.

proposals.title: Create mission progress dashboard candidate
proposals.description: Summarize autonomy milestones and blocked live capabilities into a dashboard fixture.
proposals.mission_relevance: Makes company progress easier for the agent team and founder to inspect.
proposals.expected_business_value: Improves continuity and reduces operational prompting.
proposals.selection_reason: Strong next step after proposal-to-bridge is proven.

proposals.title: Prepare first low-risk real business task candidate
proposals.description: Draft a future candidate for live business work without executing or contacting anyone.
proposals.mission_relevance: Moves toward commercial action while keeping live gates blocked.
proposals.expected_business_value: Clarifies what must be true before future business work.
proposals.selection_reason: Useful but should wait until dashboard refresh loop exists.

proposals.title: Create observation-to-work backlog refinement
proposals.description: Refine observation-derived work candidates into scored governed proposals.
proposals.mission_relevance: Improves the recurring loop from observation to prioritized work.
proposals.expected_business_value: Turns observation ticks into a stronger autonomous work queue.
proposals.selection_reason: Good follow-on once first proposal-to-bridge path is stable.
